name: Dr. [Name]
lede: Writer of books on language, memory and the Arabic word. Painter of what the word cannot hold.
a1: Dr. [Name] holds a doctorate in Arabic literature and has spent his life between the manuscript and the canvas. His books study how a single word carries a civilisation; his paintings begin where the sentence ends.
a2: He writes in Arabic and is read in translation across several countries. In the studio he works in ink, pigment and paper, often using the line of the calligrapher as the first stroke of a painting.
s_books: Selected works, shown here for reading and reference.
s_paint: Ink and pigment on paper and canvas.
s_paint2: Select a painting to open it full screen and zoom in.
q: A word is a small house; a painting is the window left open.
cp: For invitations, translations, exhibitions and press.
